rules.rule: Before every real FDTD run, check for fdtd-solutions, fdtd-engine, mpiexec, py, and python drivers. Start no new run while another .fsp is active.
Reject any spectrum whose physical transmission metric exceeds 1.0 at any point unless the monitor normalization is proven to be nonphysical and corrected.
Do not judge peak quality until mesh, simulation time, auto shutoff, and stability-factor variants give consistent peak position, peak height, linewidth, and background.
Transmission acceptance requires a single field monitor run at the relevant resonator plane; the field map must explain the resonance mechanism.
Unjustified parameter changes are limited to at most three; every meaningful sweep must be tied to mechanism, prior iteration evidence, or a diagnostic hypothesis.
Prefer changing one dominant variable per iteration so that spectral changes remain attributable.
Keep original .fsp files, logs, spectra, field data, images, metrics, and reports for every simulated case.
Check nonphysical values and oscillation first, convergence second, field mechanism third, then peak height, FWHM, and clean background.
